pipeline_audit.conclusion: The worker has access to the required analytic facts, but the current neutral evidence and semantic boundaries discard them before verification.

face: Face.geomType() returns CYLINDER for analytic cylindrical surfaces.
Face._geomAdaptor() returns an OpenCascade cylindrical surface adaptor.
The adaptor exposes Radius() and Axis() with location and direction.
Face.BoundingBox(), Face.Edges(), Face.Wires(), Center(), and wrapped.Orientation() are available.
edge: Edge.geomType() returns CIRCLE for circular boundary edges.
Edge.radius(), arcCenter(), and BoundingBox() expose analytic circle facts.
Face-to-edge ownership can be reconstructed by matching TopoDS edges with wrapped.IsSame.
Edge.Faces() did not provide usable face ownership in this characterization and is not treated as the adjacency contract.
important_limitations: Face orientation alone does not identify a hole: the filleted-host control contained both forward and reversed exterior cylindrical faces.
Circular edge count is boundary-loop count, not physical-hole count.
A cylindrical face is not by itself a hole; bosses, pins, recesses, fillets, counterbores, and transitions also produce cylinders.

synthetic_brep_matrix.dimensions_policy: All shapes were created synthetically with arbitrary dimensions and no development-project identifiers, names, source, or frozen dimensions.

through_blind_analysis.decision: Do not make universal through/blind claims in the first neutral contract without a broader topology characterization.

proposed_neutral_evidence_contract.scope: one executed revision and one canonical output_id

fields.physical_feature_id: deterministic identifier only within this revision/output evidence package
fields.feature_type: analytic_cylindrical_opening initially; stepped/counterbored and transition types explicit when supported
fields.axis: canonical axis line with direction normalization rules
fields.reference_point: analytic center/reference point for the feature
fields.diameter_mm: derived from analytic radius, not an independently selected target
fields.axial_interval_mm: analytic extent for each constituent surface and/or grouped feature
fields.circular_opening_refs: revision-local circular-edge references, centers, and radii
fields.constituent_surface_refs: revision-local face references, surface types, and topology relationships
fields.opening_count: number of independently evidenced exterior openings when determinable
fields.grouping_basis: deterministic topology/axis/interval facts used for a supported group
fields.classification_status: supported, unsupported, or ambiguous; no requirement-targeted confidence score

explicit_exclusions: expected requirement diameter, count, or spacing must not be extractor inputs
persistent face IDs across arbitrary revisions are not promised
STL candidate counts are not physical_feature_id values
unresolved ambiguity must not become PASS

identity_and_scope.revision_local_identity: A physical_feature_id may be a deterministic signature/ordinal over canonicalized B-Rep facts within one executed revision and output evidence package.
identity_and_scope.user_identity: The requirement ledger requirement_id remains stable across revisions and is separate from physical_feature_id.
identity_and_scope.output_identity: Every feature record is attached to exactly one canonical output_id; no cross-output feature matching is legal.
identity_and_scope.revision_change: A regenerated model may receive a different revision-local physical_feature_id while satisfying the same persistent requirement.
identity_and_scope.current_integration: The existing workflow already keys topology and STL paths by output_id; proposed B-Rep evidence should use the same centralized output-scope resolver.

permitted_future_roles: coarse candidate discovery when B-Rep evidence is unavailable
stl_candidate_role.prohibited_role: STL raw or matching candidate count must not establish physical-hole identity, count, authoritative diameter, centers, patterns, or through/blind state.

clean_analytic_cylindrical_opening.basis: Synthetic controls show a reusable, requirement-independent analytic fact set for clean cylindrical openings, and the worker already has access to those facts.

stepped_counterbored.basis: Connected transition topology plus contiguous same-axis bands is promising, but it needs an explicit grouping extractor and independent tests.

countersunk_and_general_transitions.basis: The feature includes non-cylindrical transition surfaces not represented by a cylinder-only identity rule.

universal_through_blind.basis: The simple planar control is distinguishable, but the current evidence does not establish a general rule for arbitrary host topology.

broad_physical_hole_ontology.basis: Bosses, pins, fillets, recesses, transitions, and stepped features prevent a single cylinder-face heuristic from being authoritative.

implementation.reason_deferred: The proposed neutral record requires worker emission and durable output-evidence persistence; reconstruction established the supported split but did not yet validate a complete production persistence contract.

product_path_assessment.result: The proposed evidence belongs to the core CAD contract and can support user-facing requirement, measured result, scope, and diagnostic messages without exposing OpenCascade internals.

future_messages.pass: Two circular holes verified at the requested diameter.
future_messages.fail: Expected two circular holes at the requested diameter; measured analytic feature evidence differs.
future_messages.unverifiable: The hole geometry is too complex for deterministic verification in the supported feature subset.

product_path_assessment.revision_support: Requirement identity remains ledger-stable while revision-local B-Rep feature identities are regenerated and compared within each evidence package.
product_path_assessment.manufacturing_boundary: No printer, build-volume, orientation, splitting, support, plate, or connector semantics were introduced.

anti_overfitting_audit.note: The synthetic matrix uses arbitrary shapes and dimensions and tests analytic relationships rather than any development project.

execution_and_verification.next_required_verification: Run the applicable full backend suite after evidence/tracker persistence; no semantic behavior should change.

Keep stepped/counterbored grouping, countersinks, and universal through/blind classification as separate subclusters; do not group STL candidates or call Gemini.
